{{Quote|Go ahead. Call the man you owe a debt to. See if he answers.''"<br />"''Boruush? Boruush!|The [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]] and [[Kavork]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Boruush''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who Trademaster [[Kavork]] of the [[Red Meteor Consortium]] pirate gang owed a gambling debt to. Prior to the [[Battle of Rishi]], the former [[Cipher Nine]] and former [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to retrieve the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Shara Jenn]] from Kavork. Cipher Nine thus [[Death/Legends|killed]] Boruush during the Minister's meeting with Kavork on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] in order to convince the pirate of the Minister's influence.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boruush appears as an enemy in "Forfeit," a class mission for the [[Imperial Agent]] in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
